description: §8.10 Tier 2 loop hoisting (RUNTIME, sqlEngine:"real"): with `<program batch-in-list-cap="2">` and four distinct keys, the hoisted pre-fetch runs in chunks of at most 2 keys and merges the results; `.get()` keeps the first row per key and `.all()` the per-key group (ORDER BY respected within each key). Each cell equals the same function compiled with `.nobatch()`. Pre-fix (2dd6d35d9, S456): more keys than the cap threw E-BATCH-002 at runtime instead of chunking, so both cells stayed "init" (host backstop).
rationale: §8.10.6: "If `xs.length` at runtime exceeds `SQLITE_MAX_VARIABLE_NUMBER`, the Tier 2 rewrite SHALL chunk the IN-list into segments of at most `SQLITE_MAX_VARIABLE_NUMBER` keys." + the S79 cap override: "The override changes BOTH the runtime check threshold AND the diagnostic message text emitted into the compiled output."
